g.text: primary / foreign / unique / logical reference column. NULL = nullable, blank = NOT NULL
user_id : uniqueidentifier — FK users.id; also UQ(user_id) while single Ruleuser_id
assigned_by : uniqueidentifier — null; FK users.id; null = systemassigned_by
from_rule_id : smallint — null for first assignmentfrom_rule_id
changed_by : uniqueidentifier — null; FK users.id; null = systemchanged_by
scope_key : varchar(100) — hash of email, or the Parent user idscope_key
guardian_user_id : uniqueidentifier — logical -> users.users.id; CHECK <> dependentguardian_user_id
dependent_user_id : uniqueidentifier — logical -> users.users.id; filtered UQ(guardian,dependent) WHERE status = Activedependent_user_id
setting_key : varchar(100) — KEY is a reserved word in SQL Serversetting_key
ticket_number : int — from a SEQUENCE; format Deferredticket_number
source_id : varchar(100) — id in the external CMSsource_id
